title: Canonical regular quotient completion unit criterion
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site and $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings. Assume countable products of $\mathcal O$-module sheaves are exact. Let $a$ be a global section whose multiplication on $\mathcal O$ is injective. For a K-flat cochain complex $P$ [def-pc-kflat-complex], put $U_n=P\otimes_{\mathcal O}\mathcal O/a^n\mathcal O$, restricted to $\mathcal O$, with quotient transitions, and $C_a(P)=\operatorname{Cone}(1-s:\prod_nU_n\to\prod_nU_n)[-1]$. Define $\eta_{a,P}:P\to C_a(P)$ to have product component the quotient maps and zero shifted-product component. Use module-derived categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Say $N$ is locally derived $(a)$-complete when, for every slice $\mathcal C/V$ and local section $f\in(a)\mathcal O(V)$, $R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_V}(\mathcal O_V[1/f],N|_V)=0$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], where localization is sheafified sectionwise. Then $C_a(P)$ is locally derived $(a)$-complete. The following are equivalent: $P$ is locally derived $(a)$-complete; $\eta_{a,P}$ is an isomorphism in $D(\mathcal O)$; there exists a distinguished Roos triangle $P\xrightarrow{(q_n)}\prod_n^D U_n\xrightarrow{1-s}\prod_n^D U_n\to P[1]$ with the prescribed quotient components [def-weil-derived-limit]. These assertions concern the specified zero-component map, not an arbitrarily chosen lift. All tensor products of module sheaves are sheafified tensor products [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], applied termwise to complexes when an ordinary tensor is written.
